_comment: Fixture gig dataset for GIG-SEARCH-P1 (variant B). 28 realistic but SYNTHETIC freelance orders. Structure mirrors Upwork-like listing payloads. No real client personal data.

gigs.title: n8n workflow to enrich inbound leads with company data
gigs.description: We receive inbound leads via webhook from our website form. Need an n8n workflow that validates the email, enriches the company domain via an API (Clearbit or similar), writes the result to Google Sheets, and posts a summary to Slack. Must be documented and easy to extend. Please provide a working demo and a short Loom walkthrough. API documentation will be shared.

gigs.title: Python scraper for 12 supplier catalogues with CSV output
gigs.description: Need a Python scraper that collects product name, SKU, price and stock status from 12 supplier websites and outputs a normalized CSV. Delivery includes unit tests and a README with instructions. Budget is fixed. Please state your approach and estimated timeline.

gigs.title: Telegram bot for internal IT support triage
gigs.description: Our service desk wants a Telegram bot where employees submit tickets. The bot must classify the request into categories using an LLM (we have an OpenAI key), create a ticket via our REST API, and reply with the ticket ID. Needs tests and documentation.

gigs.title: FastAPI webhook service with PostgreSQL persistence
gigs.description: Build a small FastAPI service that receives webhooks from our payment provider, validates the signature, stores events in PostgreSQL, and exposes an endpoint for replay. Docker compose setup required. Acceptance criteria: passing pytest suite and docker compose up works from scratch.

gigs.title: Cold calling specialist to book 20 demos per week
gigs.description: We need a sales representative to make outbound cold calls to US-based SMB owners and book demos. Must be available during US EST business hours daily for phone calls. Commission-based with a small base. No experience needed, earn daily.

gigs.title: MLOps engineer for model deployment pipeline
gigs.description: We are looking for an MLOps engineer. This role is only open to EU-based residents due to data residency requirements. Must be based in the EU and have work authorization in the EU.

gigs.title: Full-stack developer for pre-revenue startup (equity only)
gigs.description: Join our exciting startup at the ground floor. Compensation is equity only until we raise our seed round. We need someone to build our MVP with React and Node. Huge opportunity, paid in equity and exposure.

gigs.title: Airtable automation to generate and email invoices
gigs.description: We track our projects in Airtable. Need an automation that generates a PDF invoice from a record, emails it to the client via Gmail, and updates the record status. Must include documentation and a test plan with acceptance criteria.

gigs.title: Senior iOS engineer for fitness tracking app
gigs.description: We need a senior iOS engineer with deep Swift and mobile development experience to build a native fitness tracking application. Includes HealthKit integration and App Store submission. Must have a strong portfolio of shipped iOS apps.

gigs.title: LLM pipeline to extract structured data from PDF contracts
gigs.description: Build a Python pipeline that takes PDF contracts, extracts parties, dates, amounts and obligations, and returns structured JSON. Use an LLM with a validation layer. We will provide sample documents and a specification. Deliverable: working demo plus a repo with tests.

gigs.title: Hourly automation consulting for small business owners
gigs.description: We need an experienced consulting partner for one-on-one strategy sessions with our clients about process automation. Requires live video calls and coaching. Ongoing long-term engagement, hourly rate negotiable.

gigs.title: Bulk data entry: 4500 records into CRM
gigs.description: We have 4500 records in a spreadsheet that must be entered into our CRM with validation and deduplication. Repetitive bulk batch process, spreadsheet based. We will provide the CSV and the target schema. Deliverable is the updated CRM export.

gigs.title: Easy remote assistant — no experience needed, earn daily
gigs.description: Simple online tasks, no experience needed. You can earn a guaranteed 300 USD per day working from home. There is a small registration fee to activate your account, then we assign tasks via WhatsApp only contact. Contact us immediately.

gigs.title: SQL reporting layer for operations dashboards
gigs.description: We need help building a reporting layer: SQL views and scheduled queries that feed our operations dashboards. Must be documented with acceptance criteria and a spec. Postgres and Linux documented environment.

gigs.title: Website redesign in Webflow for SaaS landing page
gigs.description: Redesign our SaaS landing page in Webflow. Requires strong graphic design and brand identity skills, a design system and pixel perfect execution. Portfolio of premium SaaS sites required. Unlimited revisions until happy.

gigs.title: Migrate 30 Power Automate flows to n8n
gigs.description: We are moving off Microsoft Power Automate. Need an automation engineer to rebuild 30 flows in n8n with equivalent logic, add error handling, and provide documentation and a rollout checklist. API access and docs available.

gigs.title: Transcribe and summarise 40 hours of interview audio
gigs.description: We have roughly 40 hours of research interviews in audio format. Need accurate transcription and per-interview summaries in a structured document. Batch processing preferred, we are flexible on tools. Whisper or similar accepted.

gigs.title: Kubernetes platform engineer for production cluster
gigs.description: Looking for a senior Kubernetes platform engineer who has run large scale production Kubernetes clusters with Terraform and Go. Must have deep experience with C++ based load balancers and Rust tooling. Long-term role.

gigs.title: Shopify to warehouse inventory sync automation
gigs.description: Build an automation that syncs inventory levels between Shopify and our warehouse API every 15 minutes, with conflict resolution and alerting via webhook. Documentation and a test plan required.

gigs.title: Internal tooling — scope to be discussed
gigs.description: We have some internal tooling work coming up. Scope and terms to be discussed later with the right candidate. Please apply with your portfolio.

gigs.title: Onboarding engineer — invite only program
gigs.description: This engagement is invite-only for our existing partner network. Closed to new freelancers. We are looking for a technical onboarding engineer to help enterprise customers integrate our API.

gigs.title: Google Sheets to REST API two-way sync
gigs.description: Need a reliable two-way sync between a Google Sheet and our internal REST API, including retries and logging. Provide documentation and a spreadsheet based test plan with acceptance criteria. Python or Apps Script welcome.

gigs.title: WordPress maintenance and security hardening
gigs.description: Ongoing WordPress maintenance: plugin updates, backup verification, security hardening and uptime monitoring across 6 sites. Requires Linux server administration experience. Monthly retainer.

gigs.title: Prompt engineering for customer support GPT assistant
gigs.description: We need prompt engineering and orchestration work for a GPT-based support assistant: system prompts, evaluation harness, regression tests on a fixed question set, and documentation. LLM API access provided.

gigs.title: Senior automation engineer — 20 hour unpaid test task required
gigs.description: Before engagement you must complete an unpaid test task of 20 hours building a full n8n integration. Payment only after full delivery of the entire engagement, no escrow. Multiple rounds of free revisions expected.

gigs.title: Tier 2 application support engineer (hourly, ongoing)
gigs.description: We need a Tier 2 application support engineer for ongoing hourly work: troubleshooting API integration issues, investigating incidents via SQL queries, and documenting resolution steps. ITSM process, VPN access and Linux servers. Documentation and ticket based work.

gigs.title: n8n workflow to enrich inbound leads with company data
gigs.description: We receive inbound leads via webhook from our website form. Need an n8n workflow that validates the email, enriches the company domain via an API (Clearbit or similar), writes the result to Google Sheets, and posts a summary to Slack. Must be documented and easy to extend. Please provide a working demo and a short Loom walkthrough. API documentation will be shared.

gigs.title: Build a trading dashboard — payment in USDT only
gigs.description: Need a dashboard built. Payment in crypto only (USDT), no escrow, paid upon full delivery. Immediate start expected today. Budget is negotiable after the first deliverable.

gigs.title: Local inventory robot operator and on-site tech support
gigs.description: Must operate our warehouse robot. Physical presence required daily at our Berlin warehouse; on-site work mandatory, no remote option. Budget: USD 800 via escrow.
